info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-Replace Healthcare Appointments Reschedule-v5-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the rescheduling of healthcare appointments, optimizing the management of patient schedules. It enables providers to effectively update appointment times while maintaining their availability and patient history. Typical consumers include healthcare providers and administrative staff who are tasked with managing appointment logistics. By utilizing this API, organizations can enhance operational efficiency and improve patient satisfaction through streamlined appointment adjustments.

put.description: This endpoint allows users to modify the date and time of an existing appointment. It requires the appointment ID and the new scheduling details to be provided in the request body.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide the necessary details for rescheduling an appointment. Ensure that all required parameters are included and formatted correctly to successfully update the appointment's time and date.

200.description: The appointment has been successfully rescheduled.
